response.sql:
WITH scope_averages AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS averaged_over
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u
    ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  avg_net_fee_rate,
  averaged_over,
  avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS distance_from_simple_mean
FROM scope_averages;

assumptions.assumption: “How far” means the signed difference between each scope average and the unweighted arithmetic mean of the scope averages; positive values are above that mean.

alternatives.interpretation: If “how far” means absolute distance, report a nonnegative difference from the same unweighted mean.
